signatures.label: Stale intent carryover
signatures.description: The reply continues to address an earlier topic after the user pivoted to a new intent.

baseConstraints: Do not change the assistant's tone or break existing channel flows
Do not change DriftGuard lock logic to make a failing lock pass

ai: Latest user intent must win over earlier topics in the composed reply

scopeImpact.ai: Customers who change topic mid-chat may be answered about the wrong thing — high abandonment risk.

signatureGoals.stale_intent_carryover: Ensure the composer anchors on the latest user intent, not an earlier superseded one.

signatureImpact.stale_intent_carryover: Users who pivot topic get answered about the wrong service — high conversion risk.

modules.shortSummary: Decides which user intent the reply should address.
commonFailureModes: anchors on the first intent instead of the latest

modules.shortSummary: Builds the final reply text from the resolved intent.

locks.name: Latest intent wins after a topic pivot
invariants: When the user pivots topic, the reply addresses the most recent intent.
The reply does not continue answering a superseded earlier intent.

turns.text: I want to return an item I bought
Sure, I can help with that.
actually never mind — can you track my order instead?

locks.driftMessage: Reply carried a stale earlier intent instead of the latest one (latest intent did not win).
